description: This Java source file contains utility methods related to processing HL7 message timestamps and times, including parsing HL7 date/time formats into java.util.Date objects, handling timezone offsets, and retrieving HL7 archive directories within the OpenMRS healthcare system platform.

classes.name: HL7Util
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to parse HL7 timestamp and time formats into Java Date objects, handle timezone offsets, and retrieve HL7 archive directories, used within the OpenMRS healthcare platform.

methods.name: parseHL7Timestamp
methods.description: Converts an HL7 timestamp string into a java.util.Date object, filling in defaults for missing parts such as month, day, and seconds, and handling timezone offsets.

methods.name: parseHL7Date
methods.description: Parses an HL7 date string (date only) into a java.util.Date object, delegating to parseHL7Timestamp.

methods.name: parseHL7Time
methods.description: Converts an HL7 time string into a java.util.Date object with date set to the epoch, focusing on the time component only.

methods.name: getTimeZoneOffset
methods.description: Retrieves the timezone offset from an HL7 timestamp or time string, or defaults to the server timezone based on a reference date.

methods.name: getHl7ArchivesDirectory
methods.description: Returns the directory where HL7 message archives are stored, using global properties and default directory names within the OpenMRS platform.
